issue.title: Poll fake-bob completion in the unchanged period-alias separator test
issue.description: In bob-mac-capture Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/CaptureSeparatorToggleTests.swift, testUnchangedAliasReplyLeavesPeriodLiteralWithoutOpeningPicker sleeps 200ms then reads FAKE_BOB_RECORD_PATH. The test file is unchanged since 90fa59d. Replace the sleep with a bounded wait for the observable capture-rewrite request and completion, keeping literal draft and no-picker assertions. Do not loosen production timeouts or modify alias behavior. Related bob-cli-jb concerns a distinct double-equals cancellation/request-count test.

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposer bob-cli-j9.2 note #2 reported fail in run 42666675195 and pass on base 90fa59d/run 42657112529 and bd06c21/run 42666602607. Lander independently read failure at line 1118 in run 42666675195 (0.250s) and passes in 42686284282 (0.207s) and 42696688042 (0.313s); test file unchanged across these revisions. One observed failure among these three independently inspected runs; broad fail rate unknown and not reproduced serially. Exact whole-tree rerun parity was not established by this lander. Source root cause is reading the subprocess record after a fixed 200ms sleep.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-j9.2 note #2 proposed this independent fixed-sleep flake; the landing audit verified the test still has its 200ms race and has no task of its own.

payload.description: Distinct fake-bob timing tests; keep separator completion polling separate from equals request-count cancellation
Confirm phase/task status, descendants, and notes for bob-cli-j9 closeout

evidence.note: Same root cause in the sibling test: CaptureSeparatorToggleTests.testOlderBobMoveAliasReplyLeavesLiteralWithoutOpeningPicker (line 1272) also sleeps 200ms before reading FAKE_BOB_RECORD_PATH. It failed (XCTAssertTrue on the capture-rewrite record) on bob-mac-capture master 1498f34, run 42912210207. That commit is docs-only on top of 62a7b70, whose run 42906549245 passed the test. Replace the fixed sleep with a bounded wait in both tests. Seen by the bob-cli-ji.7.1 land agent.
